chunks: And the Day He will call them and say: 'Where are My partners, whom you used to claim?'

key_terms.شُرَكَائِيَ: My partners (those associated with God in worship)

ai.seo_question: What does God ask the polytheists on the Day of Judgment regarding their false gods?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the ultimate futility of *shirk* (associating partners with God), illustrating that false deities will be rendered powerless and unable to intercede for their worshippers. It serves as a profound reminder of divine justice, where the claimants of polytheism are left alone with their own deeds, highlighting the transition from perceived multiplicity to absolute monotheistic reality.
